lockedFeatures: hybrid half-hidden construction: smooth concealed fly fold over the upper front with zero visible buttons
crisp horizontal transition line at mid-chest where the concealed section ends
visible conventional plain placket band below the transition with evenly spaced 4-hole mother-of-pearl buttons
placket runs continuously to the hem and never terminates in a pointed popover tab
front view, white cotton poplin, plain light-grey studio background, no annotation or red notation carried over
notes: Attempt 1 failed critically: it rendered a popover / short half-placket whose strip stopped at the sternum in a pointed tab end, leaving the lower front with no placket at all - a different garment. Attempt 2 fixed the construction (concealed upper, buttoned visible lower, continuous to hem) but pulled back to a full-torso shot in which the placket filled far too little of the frame. Attempt 3 kept the corrected construction and tightened the crop; the concealed-to-visible transition now sits near the centre of the frame and reads within a second. No oscillation occurred between attempts 2 and 3 - attempt 3 is strictly the better frame. Retry budget spent at 3.
